answer:
Use interFoam, not twoPhaseEulerFoam, in system/controlDict by setting application to interFoam.
Create the 2D domain with blockMesh as a 0.584 m by 0.584 m square.
Extrude the mesh exactly one cell in the z direction, with the front and back patches named frontAndBack and set to the empty patch type.
Use a uniform Cartesian mesh in the x-y plane with 100 cells in x, 100 cells in y, and 1 cell in z.
Set the bottom and side boundaries to wall patches.
Set the top boundary to an atmosphere patch.
Initialize U to uniform (0 0 0).
Initialize p_rgh to uniform 0.
Initialize alpha.water to uniform 0.
Use setFields with a boxToCell region from (0 0 0) to (0.292 0.292 0.001) and set alpha.water to 1 inside that box, leaving it 0 outside.
Set U on the bottom and side walls to fixedValue with uniform (0 0 0).
Set p_rgh on the bottom and side walls to zeroGradient.
Set alpha.water on the bottom and side walls to zeroGradient.
Set p_rgh on the top atmosphere boundary to fixedValue with uniform 0.
Set U on the top atmosphere boundary to zeroGradient.
Set alpha.water on the top atmosphere boundary to inletOutlet with the inlet value set to 0.
Set gravity g to (0 -9.81 0).
Set water properties to density 1000 kg/m3 and kinematic viscosity 1e-6 m2/s.
Set air properties to density 1 kg/m3 and kinematic viscosity 1.48e-5 m2/s.
Set the runtime controls for the transient simulation, for example endTime 0.5 s, deltaT 1e-4 s, and writeInterval 0.005 s.
